**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update guidance when removing the VirtualField checker**

This replacement removes the only invocation of `AdviceVirtualFieldUsageChecker`, but `.github/agents/knowledge/javaagent-virtual-fields.md:116-119` still tells contributors that this checker rejects `VirtualField.find(...)` in non-inlined advice. Because repository code investigations are required to consult these knowledge articles, a future advice change can now rely on a CI safeguard that no longer exists; update that guidance to retain the prohibition without promising checker enforcement.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L22](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/8275a7710f22236fe39793d74d0b9bbd3ebbdeb3/AGENTS.md#L20-L22)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
